## SECTION 6.5. KELLY SIZING

Using the scenario odds as win/loss probabilities against a $200 entry:

- Average payoff if win (bull to ~$145–200+, use +30%): b ≈ 0.30. Average loss if loss (base/bear to ~$90, use −55%): a ≈ 0.55.
- **Full Kelly f* = (p·b − q·a)/b = (0.575×0.30 − 0.425×0.55)/0.30 = (0.1725 − 0.2338)/0.30 = −0.20.**

**Full Kelly is negative (−20%)** — i.e., at $200 the edge is negative and Kelly says *no position / short*.
